notes.sol: The source’s reproduced confidence intervals are [0.82,1.00], [0.32,0.55], [0.73,1.02] and [0.52,0.84] for C1–C4, respectively. These support the numerical differences but are not added as extra gold claims.
notes.claude: Reconciled with the second labeller (see reconciliation.md). The final judgement is the structured label; notes_blind_original keeps the pre-reconciliation blind notes, which are historical and superseded wherever they conflict with the final label.
notes.claude_blind_original_historical: Puzzle for the reconciler: the regression behind Figure 4b (C6, b = 0.174) reproduces, yet the ±1 SD predicted means (C1-C4) do not, and the report says Figure 4 'Code generates the data, but not the figure' (p.6). The report does not say whether the predicted means came from shipped code or replicator-written prediction code, nor why they differ; hence medium confidence and P2 rather than P1. The version pin lists two deposits each of Analyses.R and Cleaning.R (2022 and later); the report does not say which it ran. Report's own summary: main results reproduced, 'discrepancies in some secondary statistics'.
